purpose: Verification of the committed baseline tokenizer with the OFFICIAL challenge code (competition/validation.py + competition/metrics.py), run locally on the real tokenizer.json produced by the Colab run.

guardrail.rule: budget = 1.15 * mean(raw fertility of ha, sw, yo, am); breach if en or fr above budget

metric_equivalence_test.purpose: Differential test: the metric implemented in notebooks/02_optimization_sweep.ipynb vs the official competition code (competition/metrics.py), on the same inputs.
metric_equivalence_test.inputs: 18 hand-picked texts across the 6 languages (including CJK, kana, hangul, Arabic presentation forms, Syriac, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Tamil, Bengali, emoji, rare Latin) encoded with the committed baseline tokenizer.json
